title: A Castle Off the Map
description: A cartographer's map points toward a fortress far beyond the ordinary roads. Find the Lost Castle and enter it. Questlog records the native `tlc:lost_castle` structure visit rather than inventing a separate discovery token.
description_completed: The Lost Castle has been found. Whatever claim its dead court once held now depends on the defenders still occupying its halls.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
